What resources are available to ensure I get the most out of Mixpanel?

Free plan ($0/month, free forever): Explore product intelligence for free, no credit card required. Includes unlimited seats, up to 1M events/month, 10K session replays/month, up to 1k MEU/month for experiments, up to 10 active feature flags, and funnels & retention analysis. Sign up at https://mixpanel.com/register/. Preferred by: copy.ai, MileIQ, Simpplr.

Growth plan (starts at $0/month, volume discounts available): Get advanced intelligence with higher limits. Includes up to 20M events/month (1M events included in the base price, additional events billed per the pricing breakdown above), up to 500K session replays/month (20K session replays/month included in the base price), 5k MEU/month included for experiments (up to 100k MEU/month with purchase of additional MEU), up to 50 active feature flags (up to 500 with purchase of additional MEU), unli

Enterprise plan (custom pricing, contact sales): Full product intelligence platform with dedicated account support. Includes up to 1T events/month, custom session replay volumes, custom experiment & feature flag volumes, unlimited alerts & anomaly detection, data verification and quality monitoring, root cause analysis, custom data and replay retention policy, a dedicated success team with priority support, and first-party tracking domains. Metric Trees is available as a paid Enterprise add-on.

Startup program: Early-stage companies founded less than 5 years ago, with up to $8M in total funding, that haven’t redeemed any other offers receive their first year free on the Startup Plan, including 1 billion events, 1 million Session Replays, unlimited experiments, and the entire product suite. Learn more at https://mixpanel.com/startups/.

What is an event? Events represent interactions between a user and your product. Think about events that you want to measure and understand. Is it a purchase? Video views? Friend requests? The first step is to send that data to Mixpanel. Our flexible data model lets you bring in events easily by connecting Mixpanel to your CDP, data warehouse, or in-house data pipelines. You can also install a Mixpanel SDK. Events-based pricing calculates the cost based on the number of events across all project

How does pricing work? Events-based pricing calculates your bill based on the number of tracked events. This model allows you to start small to keep your initial costs down and scale your analytics confidently as you grow. You can purchase our Growth plan online. If you need more help customizing an option that works for you, reach out to our sales team.For full details on our pricing, please visit our docs.

How can I estimate my event volume? It depends on your number of active users and the number of events (interactions) a typical active user performs in your product every month (or year). These interactions include client-side engagement events (e.g., search, purchase, video view), server-side events (e.g., sign up, account upgrade), and messaging events (e.g., email sent, email opened, etc.).
